name: Alix Perez
blurb: Belgian D&B don known for genre-crossing productions spanning liquid, halftime and beyond.
bio: Alix Perez (Alix Depauw) is a Belgian drum & bass DJ/producer who began producing at 17 and released his debut album 1984 on Shogun Audio in 2009, followed by Chroma Chords in 2013. In 2016 he founded 1985 Music, a label and clothing imprint spanning drum & bass, dubstep, halftime and IDM. He has collaborated widely across the scene, including as one half of Shades with Eprom, and remains a respected voice for boundary-pushing D&B production.

name: Darwin
blurb: Berghain's REEF founder, weaving UK bass, breaks, techno and D&B into ocean-deep sets.
bio: Darwin is a Canada-born, Berlin-based DJ, label head and event organizer who founded REEF in 2014, Berghain's dedicated night for UK bass culture spanning dubstep, jungle, breaks and drum & bass. Darwin also runs the SPE:C record label, launched in 2015, and more recently the label Biofield Records. Mixes for Fact (Fact Mix 870) and a Boiler Room x Dekmantel back-to-back set with re:ni showcase a style spanning dubstep, techno, breaks and UK garage.

name: Dbridge
blurb: Exit Records founder and Autonomic pioneer known for atmospheric, halfstep-leaning D&B.
bio: dBridge (Darren White) is an English drum & bass producer active since the genre's early-1990s inception, first as one half of Sewer Monsters and then Future Forces Inc., before joining the D&B supergroup Bad Company UK in the late '90s. He left Bad Company in 2003 to found Exit Records, an outlet for a more experimental, atmospheric sound. In 2009 he and Instra:mental launched the influential Autonomic podcast and club night, showcased on FabricLive.50 in 2010.

name: Esposito
blurb: Berlin-based REEF resident spinning slow-building, tension-heavy Drum & Bass sets.
bio: Ricardo Esposito is a Hamburg-born, Berlin-based DJ and mastering engineer who began mixing drum & bass, jungle and trip-hop around 2001 before relocating to Berlin in 2005. A resident DJ at Darwin's REEF party at Berghain, he plays almost exclusively drum & bass, building sets with slow-burning tension inspired by LTJ Bukem & MC Conrad's Progression Sessions series. He also works professionally as a mastering engineer for electronic music.

name: Headhunter
blurb: Bristol dubstep originator revisiting the murky, jungle-inflected sound that built his name.
bio: Headhunter is an alias of Bristol producer Antony 'Tony' Williams, who emerged in the mid-2000s with releases on Tempa including the Initiate EP (2007) and the album Nomad (2008), blending dubstep with jungle, techno and dubtech textures. He later moved into juke- and footwork-inflected sounds under the alias Addison Groove, but continues to perform and release as Headhunter, revisiting the darker, sub-heavy productions that built his reputation.

name: Carré
blurb: Fast At Work co-founder and rising dubstep voice pushing the genre's foundations into bold new territory.
bio: Carré (Carré Orenstein) is a US-born, London-based producer and DJ, and co-founder of Fast At Work, the underground party series and label that grew from Los Angeles into an internationally touring imprint. Her sound blends dubstep with percussive, higher-tempo leftfield techno, with releases including 2024's Soft Fascination and Air Sign on Darwin's SPE:C label, plus 2025 releases on the storied Tempa and on EMA's Woozy imprint. Named one of Mixmag's Top Artists to Watch in 2026, she has played Panorama Bar, FOLD, The White Hotel and Outlook Festival.

name: Dubrunner
blurb: Berlin-based Menace label boss channeling steppers dub, jungle and breakbeat through a modernist soundsystem lens.
bio: Dubrunner (Charlie) is a UK-born, Berlin-based producer and DJ who runs the Menace label, an outlet for his take on dubwise soundsystem culture spanning steppers, dub and digi productions as a springboard into breakbeat hardcore, jungle and techno. He has shared bills with Iration Steppas, Goldie, Call Super and Addison Groove, with recent Menace releases including the Fallen Tree (2024) and Blackheart (2025) EPs. He describes his own sound as 'Industrial Reggae.'

name: Jan Loup
blurb: Toulouse producer weaving modern dubstep, deep D&B and percussive halftime into immersive sonic collages.
bio: Jan Loup is a Toulouse-based producer, DJ and sound technician active since 2018, working from a secluded hut studio to build sets that fuse modern dubstep, deep drum & bass, percussive halftime and tribal textures. An integral figure in Toulouse's alternative nightlife, she co-runs Le Comité Des Fêtes, a sound-system-culture collective, and is part of the ambient collective Aïra. She released her first EPs on Nerve Collect and Jupiter4 in 2024, followed by a collaborative EP with Beatrice M. on Priori's NAFF label and a release on the storied Tempa in 2025.

name: Le Motel & Magugu
blurb: Brussels producer Le Motel and Cardiff-based pidgin-rap vocalist Magugu, longtime collaborators fusing organic percussion, dub weight and vocal bass.
bio: Le Motel (Fabien Leclercq) is a Brussels-based producer, DJ and film composer whose work blends field-recorded, organic textures with footwork, dub, hip-hop and techno; he runs the Maloca label and released the acclaimed 2015 album OKA. Magugu is a Nigerian-born, Cardiff-based vocalist and 'pidgin rap' experimentalist fusing dancehall, grime, dub, hip-hop and drum & bass with Nigerian pidgin English, earning support from Gilles Peterson and Skrillex. The pair have collaborated since 2021, releasing the Kindness Weakness (2023) and Bitter Better (2025) EPs on Maloca, and appear at REEF as a dedicated back-to-back pairing.
